item.title: My Protogen Engineer ⚙️
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Dirty Fox Games
  • 発売日: 2024-10-25
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: My Protogen Engineer ⚙️
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

My Protogen Engineer tells the story of Marven, a Protogen mercenary who almost died on his last mission. Gladly, his teammates brought him to the only person who could save him - Xena. Being a very talented engineer, Xena saved Marven’s brain and transplanted it into a functional mechanical body. Now he has to adapt to his new life and find a new purpose, a new meaning to his life. But at least he’s not alone, Xena will be there to help him!

  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Furry Boss is a kinetic novel about which can be described as a compilation of comedy stories about a simple clerk and his everyday work with his new boss, Nina.

Nina is quite an unusual boss - she never acts serious, likes to tease her workers and fool around with them. Apparently, our hero is quickly becoming her main target, and now he has to adapt to his new office life with this “devil boss”.

あらすじ

Once upon a time there was a king and queen who lived in a castle with their beautiful daughter. One night an evil dragon captured the beautiful princess and locked her up in his tall, dark tower. The king and queen were very sad. They promised to give a bag of gold to the knight that rescued the princess… bla bla bla, you know the story. But dragons have feelings too. Maybe its better to “fight” them in some more interesting ways?"

item.title: My Furry Maid 🐾
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Dirty Fox Games
  • 発売日: 2022-11-19
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: My Furry Maid 🐾
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Okay, to be fair - we don’t have a real made here, but we have a hot actress who wants to be one! And she wears a maid costume anyway, so who cares?

My Furry Maid is a kinetic novel about a guy who works as a teacher in a housekeeping school and his new student Anna. She wants to study maid classes for a role in a TV-Show, so he’ll have to teach her etiquette, housing and cooking for a whole week. How long will she last until falling in love with him? Let’s find out!

  • スコア: 5.15/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: My Furry Teacher 🐾
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Confidence, determination, hard work. These things made you the best math teacher in your town, who’s loved by students and respected by other teachers. However, nothing has changed in recent years, you work in the same classroom, with the same educational material and same wage. But what exactly could you do? Maybe it’s truly the limit of your ambitions? Is it ok to live like this your whole life?…

  • 日本語名: My Furry Detective 🐾
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Not everyone can be a detective, it requiers a lot of practical skills and logical thinking. Some people, however, try to achieve their dreams despite common sense. Your new partner, Eva, is just this type of person - no skills, but full of motivation to become the best detective in this city. Nobody could be her partner for more than a month, everybody in agency makes bets on how long you may stay with her.

あらすじ

Your life is a true success story - you have achieved your dreams, becames rich and got everything you’ve ever wanted. There is nothing that you can’t buy now. But why can’t you feel happy? Is this what you wanted?… Everything changes when your personal plane crashes in the ocean and you find yourself on an unknown island, which changes your life completly in the next few days.
